name: grabcycle-functions
description: GrabCycle trusted backend: Cloud Functions for Firebase (2nd gen)

scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-grabcycle --only auth,firestore,database,storage --config ../../firebase.json "vitest run --project integration --project rules"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulator
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-grabcycle --config ../../firebase.json
